objective: Verify determinism across different valid launch geometries and repeated runs.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run the geometries on Ascend 950PR, and capture all odata buffers.
pass_condition: Pass iff every run is bitwise identical to the host oracle and to every other run.
setup: Run the same input and shifts with at least three tiling configurations (single row of threads, 16x16 tiles, single column of tiles) on the future candidate; capture odata for each.
